verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 resolves both prior major findings. The path now includes a stable per-operation identity, distinct same-value writers therefore create distinct immutable objects, and same-value maximum-generation ties resolve deterministically without a permanent provenance conflict. Step 0 re-lists and rediscovers an already-landed `(PR, op)` record before allocating a generation, so an ambiguous PUT result or workflow-attempt restart does not fabricate another transition. The body-equivalence contract, loser-delete deferral, four-valued resolver, stale-tie sweep, directory ceiling, and required non-vacuous interleaving tests are stated explicitly and consistently with those invariants. This design record changes no behavior, and I found no remaining diff-scoped correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue.
